_comment: Passport / visa photo specifications. All linear measurements are in millimetres.
dpi                     : print resolution the pixel canvas is built at
head_min_mm / head_max_mm : chin-to-crown height (crown = top of head INCLUDING hair)
head_target_mm          : what this tool aims for (defaults to the midpoint)
eye_min_mm / eye_max_mm : eye line measured UP from the bottom edge (optional)
crown_gap_frac          : used only when a spec gives no eye rule - the gap above
the crown, as a fraction of photo height
These encode the published national guidance as of 2026-09. Requirements do change:
check the issuing authority before you pay for prints. `units` is presentation only.

us.name: United States - Passport, Visa, Green Card (2x2 in)
us.notes: 2x2 in. Head 1 to 1-3/8 in. Eyes 1-1/8 to 1-3/8 in from bottom. Plain white or off-white.

india_passport.name: India - Passport (2x2 in)
india_passport.notes: Matches the US 2x2 geometry. Plain white background, no border.

schengen.name: Schengen / EU - Passport & Visa (35x45 mm)
schengen.notes: ICAO 9303. Head 70-80% of frame height. Light grey or off-white background.

uk.name: United Kingdom - Passport (35x45 mm)
uk.notes: Head (chin to crown) 29-34 mm. Plain light grey or cream background.

canada.name: Canada - Passport (50x70 mm)
canada.notes: Face 31-36 mm chin to crown. Plain white or light-coloured background.

australia.name: Australia - Passport (35x45 mm)
australia.notes: Head 32-36 mm. Plain light-coloured background, no shadows.

japan.name: Japan - Passport (35x45 mm)
japan.notes: Head 32-36 mm, 2-6 mm clearance above the crown.

china_visa.name: China - Visa (33x48 mm)
china_visa.notes: Head 28-33 mm, width 15-22 mm. Plain white background.

icao.name: ICAO 9303 generic (35x45 mm)
icao.notes: Fallback for any country that simply cites ICAO 9303.

linkedin_headshot.name: Square headshot for profiles (not a travel document)
linkedin_headshot.notes: 800x800 px at 300 dpi. Looser crop than a travel document - profile use only.
